**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DENIAL**

**Service:** Open Sleeve Gastrectomy (CPT 43843)  
**Order Date:** April 24, 2025  
**Decision:** DENIED

---

**Criteria Review:**

**BMI Requirement – MET**  
Current BMI of 46.7 kg/m² (4/16/2025) exceeds the required minimum of 35 kg/m².

**Obesity-Related Comorbidities – MET**  
Patient has documented active conditions: Essential hypertension (since 2/27/2018), Hyperlipidemia (since 8/15/2019), and Osteoarthritis of knee (since 3/27/2023).

**Prior Weight Management – MET**  
Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial, with minimal weight loss (2 kg) that was subsequently regained. Treating physician documented this as unsuccessful.

**Covered Procedure Type – NOT MET**  
Open sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43843) is not a covered bariatric procedure under this plan. Our policy covers laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy and other specified laparoscopic bariatric procedures only.

---

**Next Steps:**

To appeal this denial, the ordering provider may submit documentation if a different procedure code was intended, or request reconsideration with additional clinical justification. Please contact our office with any questions.
